mapper.sql: SELECT e.*, tc.tc_code, tc.title AS tc_title, tc.module AS tc_module, tc.priority AS tc_priority, tc.version AS current_tc_version, a.name AS assignee_name, x.name AS executed_by_name FROM test_execution e JOIN test_case tc ON tc.id = e.test_case_id LEFT JOIN users a ON a.id = e.assignee_id LEFT JOIN users x ON x.id = e.executed_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_execution (cycle_id, test_case_id, tc_version, assignee_id) SELECT #{cycleId}, tc.id, tc.version, #{assigneeId} FROM test_case tc WHERE tc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND tc.review_status = 'APPROVED' AND tc.project_id = (SELECT c.project_id FROM test_cycle c WHERE c.id = #{cycleId}) AND tc.id IN #{id} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM test_execution e WHERE e.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND e.test_case_id = tc.id)
mapper.update: UPDATE test_execution SET result = #{result}, executed_by = #{executedBy}, executed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_execution_history (execution_id, result, comment, executed_by) VALUES (#{executionId}, #{result}, #{comment}, #{executedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT h.*, u.name AS executed_by_name FROM test_execution_history h LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = h.executed_by WHERE h.execution_id = #{executionId} ORDER BY h.executed_at DESC, h.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_execution_history WHERE execution_id = #{executionId}
